podcast.title: Influence on Slide Guitarists
podcast.body: Blind Willie Johnson's slide guitar playing significantly influenced numerous country musicians and renowned rock artists. Among those he influenced are Rye Cooder, Brian Jones and Keith Richards of The Rolling Stones, and Duane Allman. "Like that, interned influence not only a billion country players, but rockers like Rye Kooter, Brian Jones and Keith Richards of the Rolling Stones and Duane Almond."
